chunks: Yūnus, from one of those who narrated it to him, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
Concerning a man who killed his owned slave: he is to be beaten severely, and the slave’s value is to be taken from him for the public treasury.

key_terms.قَتَلَ: killed; unlawfully caused the death of
key_terms.قِيمَتُهُ: his monetary value or assessed price
key_terms.لِبَيْتِ الْمَالِ: for the public treasury of the Muslim community
key_terms.يُضْرَبُ: he is to be beaten as a legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man kills his own slave according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who kills his own slave. It states that he is to receive a severe beating and that the slave’s monetary value is taken from him and assigned to Bayt al-Mal.
